links.comparator_used: Deployed model before fine-tuning (static model with the performance decline on inference data)
links.outcome: Recovery of image classification performance metrics after a detected decline
links.effect: Performance discrepancies between test and inference data were detected in 8 of 18 models; for declines of up to 40.6% (cardiomegaly dataset, InceptionV3), fine-tuning restored metrics to within 2% of baseline values.
links.quote: In cases with declines of up to 40.6% (cardiomegaly dataset, InceptionV3), fine-tuning restored performance metrics to within 2% of baseline values.
